title: Solve the Mystery
question: Mars, 2012. Our rover has discovered these stones. Something may have carried them here a very long time ago. What happened?

shape.title: Shape detectives
shape.text: These stones have rounded edges. When stones roll and knock against each other over time, their sharp corners can wear away.

size.title: Size detectives
size.text: These are not just tiny grains of dust. According to scientists, the pebbles were too large for wind to explain how they were transported.

rock.title: Rock detectives
rock.text: Small stones and grains of sand are held together inside hardened rock. Before they became solid rock, these materials collected together.

earth.title: Earth detectives
earth.text: On Earth, flowing water can move sand and pebbles. Stones become rounder as they roll and knock together. When the current slows down, it leaves material behind.

conclusion: The evidence suggests that an ancient stream once flowed through this place. Water carried the pebbles and sand, which eventually formed a hardened deposit.
